title: Why Agentic Workflows Fail: A Taxonomy Derived from Literature and Empirical Data
abstract: arXiv:2610.17418v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Agentic workflows combine large language models with planning, memory, tools, execution environments, and iterative feedback. Their failures are difficult to diagnose because the same user-visible symptom may originate from model behavior, workflow orchestration, external tools, infrastructure, or their interaction. This paper presents a source-aware taxonomy of agentic workflow failures and applies it to evidence from academic literature and GitHub. The taxonomy combines source attribution with three empirical dimensions: a concrete failure-type dictionary, workflow-stage localization, and agent-capability localization. Its central structure is a two-axis localization matrix: workflow stages form the horizontal process axis and agent capabilities form the vertical functional axis. This design moves beyond taxonomies that mainly classify final failure manifestations by localizing intermediate process states inside agent operation. Our

translated_title: 智能体工作流为何失败：基于文献与实证数据的失败分类体系
translated_abstract: 智能体工作流将大语言模型与规划、记忆、工具、执行环境以及迭代反馈相结合。其失败难以诊断，因为相同的用户可见症状可能源自模型行为、工作流编排、外部工具、基础设施或它们之间的交互作用。本文提出了一个故障源感知的智能体工作流失败分类体系，并将其应用于来自学术文献和GitHub的证据。该分类体系将故障源归因与三个实证维度相结合：具体的失败类型词典、工作流阶段定位以及智能体能力定位。其核心结构是一个双轴定位矩阵：工作流阶段构成水平的过程轴，智能体能力构成垂直的功能轴。这一设计超越了主要对最终失败表现进行分类的传统分类体系，能够定位智能体运行过程中的中间状态。我们的……
tldr: 本文提出了一个故障源感知的智能体工作流失败分类体系，其核心是通过“工作流阶段×智能体能力”的双轴定位矩阵来定位智能体运行过程中的中间失败状态，超越了仅对最终失败表现进行分类的传统方法。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a source-aware taxonomy of agentic workflow failures, featuring a two-axis localization matrix (workflow stages × agent capabilities) that pinpoints intermediate process states during agent operation, moving beyond taxonomies that merely classify final failure manifestations.
